configuration.helperOrigin: same origin as browser platform page

negativeBaseline.explanation: Old completion recognizer only accepted POST /exit. INK4 success page explicitly calls POST /reboot; credentials were saved but automatic completion stopped. The initial observation probe did not assert this condition, so its null failure field is not acceptance.

manualDiagnostic.result: Guest rebooted, associated and parsed a real OTA response; old provisioning status remained error. Diagnostic only, not automatic acceptance.

browserAcceptance.visualInspection: Actual guest pixels show a clear activation-required title, Wi-Fi icon, clock/date and six home applications, without overlaid old title strokes. Activation text is private and is not reproduced.

limitations: Real application response was tested through a caller-configured local helper. Public relay availability or arbitrary browser Origins were not qualified.
Account activation, authenticated voice/chat, audio, BLE, 4G, RF and physical hardware were not validated.
This does not certify service behavior after the fixed test date or other firmware versions.
Optical e-paper response and physical PSRAM capacity remain unverified.

privacy.retained: Hashes, protocol endpoint path, statuses, counters, fixed firmware identity and numeric frame receipts.
privacy.omitted: Helper token/endpoint, full success HTML, serial logs, device/network identifiers, activation code and screenshot bytes. Raw observations remain only in ignored output/.
privacy.effect: No activation secret or identity can be recovered from this receipt; exact raw artifacts can be hash-checked locally.
